title: Concession with a pesar de: murals and identity

sections.content: You know *a pesar de* + noun or infinitive, *a pesar de que* + a clause and *pese a* from B1 Unit 32. They admit a difficulty or a contrast and go on: something is true even though something else might suggest the opposite. Use them to describe the artists and movements of the 1920s.

items.spanish: A pesar de que los tres pintores tenían estilos distintos, todos pintaron la historia del país.
items.english: Although the three painters had different styles, all of them painted the history of the country.

items.spanish: A pesar de las críticas, el movimiento siguió creciendo.
items.english: Despite the criticism, the movement kept growing.

items.spanish: A pesar de ese interés por el pasado, muchas comunidades siguieron en la pobreza.
items.english: Despite that interest in the past, many communities stayed poor.

items.spanish: Pese a las diferencias, los artistas buscaron una identidad propia.
items.english: Despite the differences, the artists looked for an identity of their own.

sections.content: Before a noun or an infinitive use *a pesar de* (*a pesar de las críticas*); before a full clause use *a pesar de que* with the indicative (*a pesar de que tenían estilos distintos*). *Pese a* means the same as *a pesar de*.
